title: Writing Black With Maiysha Kai
description:
S01 E03 — The Son of Baldwin, Robert Jones Jr.
Maiysha talks with New York Times bestselling author and "Son of Baldwin" creator Robert Jones Jr. about his book "The Prophets"; he explains how he came up with the concept of a novel about Black queer love during slavery.

title: Writing Black With Maiysha Kai
description:
S01 E04 — From the Big Screen to Your Book Shelf, Legendary Actor Omar Epps
Maiysha Kai sits down with actor Omar Epps, who gives an introspective look at his love for hip-hop, the film industry and the importance of being prepared for success.

title: Writing Black With Maiysha Kai
description:
